## Impact Checklist

- [ ] Component or public API impact is described
- [ ] Theme token impact is described or not applicable
- [ ] Motion token impact is described or not applicable
- [ ] Element Plus compatibility impact is described or not applicable
- [ ] Visual snapshot impact is described or not applicable
- [ ] Accessibility impact is described or not applicable
- [ ] README or docs updated, or docs are not needed

## Release Notes

- [ ] Changeset added for user-facing package changes
- [ ] Changeset not needed because this is internal-only
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked in the changeset and migration docs

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm run lint`
- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm run test`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] `pnpm run test:visual` if UI, theme, motion, layout, icons, or demo output changed
- [ ] `pnpm run test:consumer-install` if public package output, exports, install flow, or registry behavior changed
